description: This Go source file defines the discovery API client for an agent management system. It includes configuration options, functions for filtering discovery queries, and the main 'Discover' function that constructs and sends HTTP requests to the control plane discovery API, then parses and returns the response data.

methods.name: WithAgent
methods.description: Creates a discovery option to filter by a single agent ID.

methods.name: WithNodeID
methods.description: Alias for WithAgent, filters discovery to a node ID.

methods.name: WithAgentIDs
methods.description: Creates a discovery option to filter by multiple agent IDs.

methods.name: WithNodeIDs
methods.description: Alias for WithAgentIDs, filters discovery by multiple node IDs.

methods.name: WithReasonerPattern
methods.description: Filters discovery by a wildcard pattern for reasoner IDs.

methods.name: WithSkillPattern
methods.description: Filters discovery by a wildcard pattern for skill IDs.

methods.name: WithTags
methods.description: Filters capabilities by tags, supporting wildcards.

methods.name: WithDiscoveryInputSchema
methods.description: Toggles inclusion of input schemas in discovery results.

methods.name: WithDiscoveryOutputSchema
methods.description: Toggles inclusion of output schemas in discovery results.

methods.name: WithDiscoveryDescriptions
methods.description: Toggles inclusion of descriptions in discovery results.

methods.name: WithDiscoveryExamples
methods.description: Toggles inclusion of examples in discovery results.

methods.name: WithFormat
methods.description: Sets the response format: json, xml, or compact.

methods.name: Discover
methods.description: Performs the discovery API request with specified options and parses the response.

methods.name: dedupe
methods.description: Removes duplicates and empty strings from a list of strings.
